sentence: This project tests approved drugs in a fruit fly model of epilepsy to look for treatments for seizures in people.
This project studies whether speech picked up by hearing aids can be used to monitor and detect early signs of Alzheimers Disease.
This project studies how probiotic bacteria interact with the body and which metabolic pathways they control.
This project checks which gene mutations change disease and studies how the proteins they affect interact and signal in cells.
This project studies how estrogen receptor and NFkB signals interact in breast cancer to find combination treatments that prevent relapse.
This project studies how affect links childhood adversity to substance use in adolescents, using laboratory and everyday-life methods.
This project tests how sample handling affects pancreatic cyst fluid assays and builds a reproducible protocol for detecting pancreatic cancer early.
This project studies how a pathway in lung immune cells controls their metabolism during infection with the bacterium that causes tuberculosis.
This project builds computational tools that use genetic variability between pathogen strains and across people to find epitopes for peptide-based vaccines.
This project builds a technology for making ions that lets researchers measure molecules in individual cells.
This project uses imaging that tracks single vesicles to study how synapses transmit signals, including in Fragile X syndrome.
This project studies how the epigenetic modifier SIN3a controls BMPR2 expression in lung vascular endothelial cells.
This project builds a machine learning framework that uses neuroimaging data to predict cognitive decline in dementia.
This project studies which protein complexes and microenvironmental regulators help colorectal cancer spread and grow in the liver and lungs.
This project looks for genetic causes of IgA vasculitis, a pediatric disorder, to understand how the disease develops.
This project characterizes the human virome across tissue types using viral sequencing, validation studies and host response tests.
This project studies how faulty kinase signaling contributes to neurological disorders, using proteomic methods and AI tools.
This project builds personalized machine learning methods to predict which hospitalized patients will develop acute kidney injury.
This project tests whether stem cells lacking the CHD7 gene can develop into thymic epithelial cells that support T cell development in mice.
